title: Fit, plunge, and turn the safety lid closed on a filled French press
instruction: Fit the plunger lid onto the French press carafe with the safety lid turned to close the pour spout, and press the plunger all the way down.
context: Making coffee in a French press is a familiar everyday home kitchen routine: the user fits the filter-and-plunger lid onto the filled glass carafe, turns the safety lid so its solid skirt closes the pour spout, and presses the plunger steadily down while steadying the carafe handle.
setup: Four objects on the station table representing a 1:1 4-cup (0.5 L) Bodum Chambord French press (model 1924-16 with official 1504-10 spare glass beaker, ~USD 35 to 45: 96 mm OD, 125 mm glass height, 166 mm overall width with handle, 190 mm overall height with plunger pressed) at working fill, prepared off-station for each real trial by dosing 25.0 +/- 0.5 g of fresh dry coarse-ground roasted coffee (0.85 to 1.0 mm French-press grind, ~USD 0.30/trial) into the clean dry beaker, adding 425 mL (425.0 +/- 5.0 g) of safe room-temperature potable water at 20 to 25 deg C (68 to 77 deg F; never hot or boiling water), stirring gently for 5 s with a plastic or wooden spoon to wet all grounds, and hydrating undisturbed for 4.0 minutes (240 +/- 15 s) before wiping the exterior dry and placing on the coaster. (1) Fixed round cork coaster (128 mm OD x 6 mm standard 5-inch cork trivet, ~USD 3, double-sided taped at x=235 mm, y=+25 mm, friction 0.28). (2) Loose filled cylindrical borosilicate-and-chrome carafe (96 mm OD x 125 mm tall 16-stave glass beaker with an engineering-estimated 3 mm wall giving a 90 mm cylindrical inner bore, 8 mm stainless footed frame base for a 133 mm rim height, hydrated coarse coffee grounds bed, open 19.2 mm x 18 mm -Y pour-spout notch at z=115 mm with spout lip, chrome frame bands/legs, and matte black PP side handle spanning to y=+118 mm for a 166 mm overall width; estimated total mass 795 g representing 345 g empty carafe + 425 g room-temperature water + 25 g coarse coffee grounds, ~450 cm^3 total brew-column volume / 78.7 mm undisturbed fill height) resting upright on the coaster with handle +Y and spout -Y. (3) Fixed stainless or 3D-printed PLA/PETG drip stand (132 mm OD x 8 mm base disc with a concentric 86 mm ID / 94 mm OD cylindrical cradle rising to 68 mm total height, ~USD 8 to 12 stainless lid/utensil rest or <USD 2 printed cradle, double-sided taped at x=245 mm, y=-165 mm). (4) Loose articulated cylindrical plunger-and-lid assembly (estimated 228 g total: 148 g one-piece safety lid + 80 g plunger) resting upright in the drip stand with its pour slot facing -Y: a 98 mm OD stepped round stainless safety lid with a flush -Y pour-slot alignment mark, a 68 mm OD x 9 mm 16-stave knurled dome crown, an 82 mm OD x 16 mm cylindrical lower pilot skirt (slotted across the three -Y staves for a 65.3-degree inner pour opening and solid across the remaining 294.7 degrees to block all rays across the 20.9-degree spout gap when rotated >=43.15 degrees), and a 22 mm OD x 34 mm cylindrical central guide collar (26 mm top nut); plus a vertical sliding 8 mm stainless plunger stem (60 mm travel, dimensionless legacy PhysX jointFriction 2.4 and estimated 85 N s/m filtration damping) carrying a 78 mm circular bottom stainless filter assembly and a 36 mm dished brass press-knob (pressed height 190 mm).
scoring: Any latched hazard permanently scores 0 (in real trials, liquid spilling over the spout/rim, liquid blow-by splashing from the spout during fast plunging/insertion, or hard drop impact against the tabletop/floor is judged directly from trial video, with the following simulation thresholds serving as proxies): hydrostatic liquid fill inside the 90 mm bore (450 cm^3 total volume -> 78.7 mm undisturbed center height) reaches the -Y pour-spout lip at z=115 mm (>38.9 degrees tilt toward -Y) or the z=133 mm rim (>50.3 degrees tilt elsewhere), downward speed of the 78 mm filter disc relative to the carafe inside the 90 mm filled brew column (0 <= z <= 78.7 mm, r <= 45 mm, monitoring both seated plunger travel and whole-lid/tilted filter entry crossings during insertion) exceeds 110 mm/s (filtration blow-by/splash hazard), or any physical perimeter point of the carafe or plunger-lid strikes the station tabletop or floor with a pre-impact downward speed exceeding 0.50 m/s; recoverable tilts below the spill threshold, gentle counter placement, or closing the safety lid either before or after plunging never penalizes the trial. Every positive score requires the carafe upright within 3 degrees, the lid seated coaxially on the carafe rim (<=6 mm radial, <=6 mm vertical, <=5 degrees tilt), both gripper pad midpoints and all four independent jaw endpoints >=80 mm from every collider surface of the carafe, coaster, drip stand, and plunger-lid assembly, and <1 mm 3D Euclidean extremal-point movement across the carafe, lid, and plunger over the final 1.0 s (21 samples at 20 Hz; checked in real trials by ruler/tape measure and 1.0 s video stillness). 0.30: lid seated coaxially on the carafe rim. 0.50: 0.30 met, plus the safety lid rotated 43.15 to 180 degrees in either direction from the carafe's -Y pour spout so its continuous 294.7-degree solid pilot skirt completely occludes the spout opening (verified visually at the spout). 0.70: 0.30 met, plus the plunger at >=52 mm final depth (within 8 mm of the 60 mm bottom stop, checked by ruler on exposed stem/knob height) with >=52 mm of net downward plunger travel accumulated while the lid is seated on the carafe (verified from trial video + ruler; depressing the plunger on the stand or off-carafe earns no pressing credit; upward plunger travel deducts and full lid removal >25 mm from the rim resets seated credit). 1.0: both 0.50 and 0.70 met (lid seated coaxially, plunger at >=52 mm final depth from >=52 mm of net seated downward travel, and safety lid rotated 43.15 to 180 degrees closing the pour spout).
reset_notes: Spill protection (before trials): flush tape-down waterproof film (<=0.2 mm) over table seams, cable ports and arm base mounts, leaving coaster and drip stand at nominal height, and absorbent pads >=150 mm outside the workspace. Each trial, off-station: 25.0 +/- 0.5 g fresh coarse-ground coffee (0.85 to 1.0 mm grind) in the clean dry beaker, 425 +/- 5 g water at 20 to 25 deg C (thermometer; never hot), stir 5 s with a plastic or wooden spoon, hydrate 4.0 min (+/- 15 s), wipe the outside dry, start within 60 s. Between trials: off-station, strain (<=0.5 mm mesh) and bin the grounds, rinse all parts in 20 to 25 deg C water, towel-dry them and the coaster and film, pull the plunger to its 0 mm top stop, set the lid upright on the drip stand (pour-slot mark to -Y), centre a fresh carafe on the coaster (handle +Y, spout -Y). Details in README.
fidelity: Rigid PhysX matches Bodum 1504-10/1924-16 0.5 L outer specs (96x125 mm beaker, 166 mm width, 190 mm pressed height; whole-lid spout closure per Chambord manual, zero adapted bosses). Rigid 78 mm filter in 90 mm bore leaves a 6 mm radial gap vs a compliant spiral mesh seal; wall/skirt/dome/collar/knob sizes, masses (345/148/80 g), legacy jointFriction 2.4, and 85 N s/m damping are estimates; fluid/grounds mechanics omitted.
